summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned Lucy Play admin panel. Logged in as admin, verified /admin dashboard (6 metric cards + range/custom-date filters), traversed all 19 sidebar nav pages (all HTTP 200, no server errors), and validated Members search, Casino engine tabs, Promotion create flow, Configuration save, sidebar collapse toggle, and logout. All flows work end-to-end.

issues: Native HTML5 date-picker used in Dashboard From/To fields — acceptable for a Blade app but could be swapped for a styled component for polish.

critical_code_review_comments: Configuration Save button in /app/resources/views/admin/settings/index.blade.php lacks an explicit type="submit" attribute. It works (default type is submit), but selectors like button[type='submit'] will miss it — worth adding for testability consistency with other forms.

Sidebar toggle button and mobile-header toggle both use the same [data-sidebar-toggle] attribute — fine, but consider distinct data-testid values (e.g., sidebar-toggle-desktop / sidebar-toggle-mobile) for future automated coverage.
The /admin/module/{module} placeholder route swallows any string; consider whitelisting known module slugs to avoid unexpected pages if a link is fat-fingered.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. A TEST_SmokeSuite promotion was created during testing and deleted afterwards. A TEST_title promotion from an earlier browser test was also cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable smoke test at /app/tests/admin_ui_smoke.py exercises login + 19 admin routes + members search + promotion CRUD + settings save + logout. It uses raw HTTP (no browser) so it's fast and regression-friendly. Playwright browser runs confirmed the visual layout: 3-col metric grid at 1920px, sidebar 264px expanded / 80px collapsed, no console errors, FontAwesome icons render, Instrument Sans / Bricolage Grotesque fonts load from Google Fonts. Design closely matches the abyssinia.games reference with a modern light theme.
verified_flows: Login admin@lucyplay.local → /admin loads (redirect from / handled by manual nav)
Dashboard 6 metric cards render with icons + labels + values (Total members=21, Total bets=206, Bet volume=ETB 249,019, Payouts=ETB 205,442, GGR=ETB 43,577, Active promotions=3)
Range tabs (Today / Last 7 days / This month / This year) update URL ?range= and highlight active tab
Custom date filter (From/To + Search) navigates with range=custom; Reset returns to default
Quick stats, Recent rounds (with seeded round data), Top players (with seeded player balances) all render
All 19 sidebar links return HTTP 200 with no Whoops/SQLSTATE — includes placeholder modules (banners, loyalty, challenges, tournaments, telegram, broadcast bot)
Members search for 'hana' filters 21 → 1 row (Hana Girma); avatars + status badges render
Casino engine renders Game/Category/Provider/Lobby tabs; 10 Edit controls detected
Promotion create POST /admin/promotions returns 'Promotion created and published.' flash and shows new row in library
Configuration save shows 'Platform settings saved.' flash
Sidebar toggle collapses aside from 264px → 80px and adds 'sidebar-collapsed' body class
